patched-llm-for-zotero-*.xpi
==========================

This .xpi is a MODIFIED build of the llm-for-zotero add-on
(https://github.com/yilewang/llm-for-zotero), Copyright Yile Wang.

Upstream licence: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0).
Therefore this modified build is distributed under AGPL-3.0.

You may redistribute it provided you:

  1. keep it under AGPL-3.0, and
  2. convey the complete corresponding source.

(2) is satisfied by this repository: zotero-patches/apply.py plus
zotero-patches/patches/*.py rebuild this exact .xpi from a stock upstream
copy you supply:

    cd zotero-patches
    python apply.py --xpi /path/to/llm-for-zotero.xpi

The build strips update_url and bumps the version to .N+1 so it cannot
silently overwrite itself from upstream. Upstream's own TypeScript sources
remain in the upstream repository and are the property of their authors.

Do not strip the notices above when redistributing.
